title: Single-pod unwind autopsies: two sourced instances
method: Tavily + Firecrawl/extract via Bloomberg syndication + Hedgeweek/eFinancialCareers mirrors; no invented numbers; paywalled Bloomberg core facts confirmed via Bloomberg Law mirror and trade-press syndication

instances.role: London head of event-driven credit; platform book set up ~3 years earlier
instances.scale: ~1% of BAM gross assets; event-driven credit sleeve ~5% of AUM (eFinancialCareers contextualizes 5%)
instances.dates: Losses in long/short Europe/US credit; liquidation began Sep 2023, team exit Dec 2023
instances.mechanism: Central liquidation of pod book Sep-Dec 2023; team departed; positions unwound by risk, not PM
instances.outcome: Pod terminated; PM resurfaced at Millennium London (eFinancialCareers 2024) after 3.5y at BAM + 6.5y at Citadel
instances.breaker_reading: Pod hit wall and was cut under platform risk rule; validates breaker as feature (~15-20% turnover), not failure

sources.cite: Bloomberg 2023-12-12/13: Balyasny Shuts Klavdianos' Trades After $100 Million Loss (Lucca de Paoli, Nishant Kumar, Irene Garcia Perez)
sources.access: paywalled; mirror confirms headline + deck: liquidation after >$100M, team left, Sep liquidation start

sources.cite: eFinancialCareers 2023-12-13: About the $100m loss at Balyasny
sources.note: FCA Register note still at BAM at time of writing; attributes $100M to US credit PM contribution plus Klavdianos sleeve

sources.cite: eFinancialCareers 2024: Hedge fund Millennium hired Balyasny London PM who left after $100m loss
sources.note: Confirms Dec exit and 2024 rehire at Millennium London

sources.cite: Hedgeweek brief via Bloomberg: George Klavdianos left Balyasny London Dec following $100m loss

instances.grade: sourced single-pod autopsy; loss figure is Bloomberg-reported >$100M (no P&L filing)

instances.trigger: Yen carry unwind + US recession jitters; Aug 5 2024: Nikkei -12.4% (worst since 1987), TOPIX -12%, VIX intraday >65, USD/JPY 161->142
instances.count: At least 6 pods shut across Millennium, Balyasny, BlueCrest (Bloomberg count, Hedgeweek syndication)
named_pods_managers: Millennium Houston: Ryan Fitzgibbon (industrials/energy stocks) — shut after losses
Millennium Asia HK: Shao Ying (index-rebalancing) — pod closed, manager exit
Millennium Asia HK: Zachary Corones (index-rebalancing) — pod closed, manager exit
BlueCrest: Chiga Murayama (JGB trading) + team Yosuke Motegi — pod shut after losses
Balyasny HK: Mark Cox ('equity guy') — departed
instances.mechanism: Pod-level liquidation under 5% halve / 7.5% terminate rule (Millennium automatic; peer platforms 7-10% band). Hedgeweek explicates: capital partially withdrawn after 5%, dismissed after ~7%.
instances.context: Bloomberg sources: rapid yen carry unwind; Hedgeweek notes funds rebounded by Aug 23 (Schonfeld +1%, LMR +0.9%, Millennium +0.7% month-to-date) — breaker damping worked at platform level
instances.adjunct: Bloomberg 2024-06-27: Balyasny closed merger-arb team (Adam Schwartz exit) and Schonfeld cut merger-arb PM Eric Fritz — same quarter, deal-chaos losses; shows pod turnover as feature

sources.cite: Bloomberg 2024-08-30: BlueCrest, Millennium Pods Faced Quick Closure After Turmoil (Nishant Kumar, Bei Hu, Takashi Nakamichi)
Hedgeweek 2024-09-02: BlueCrest and Millennium closed pods amid market turmoil (Bloomberg syndication, free)
sources.note: Lists Ryan Fitzgibbon, Shao Ying, Zachary Corones, Chiga Murayama, Yosuke Motegi, Mark Cox; states 5% halve / 7% dismiss rule

sources.cite: MoneyControl 2024-08-26 (Bloomberg syndication): Millennium shuts two trading pods in Asia (Shao Ying, Zachary Corones)
Bloomberg 2024-06-27: Balyasny, Schonfeld Cut Merger Arb Traders After Bad Bets (Adam Schwartz / Eric Fritz)

instances.grade: sourced multi-pod cluster autopsy; validates breaker thresholds as binding (pods were cut at wall), not proof of platform failure

evidence_grade_update: Pod breaker thresholds: measured industry fact (Millennium 5%/7.5% automatic; 15-20% turnover; Citadel negotiated equivalents) — pods_goodhart_v1.json. Single-pod unwinds: now sourced (2 instances above, this file). Platform-level unwinds: Balyasny 2018 / Eisler 2025 / Q1-2026 synchronized remain separate (pods_chaebol_instances_v1.json). Remaining analogical: internal backstop structure (cross guarantees/shared funding/rehypothecation) until primary filing.
limits: Loss figures are Bloomberg-reported, not audited P&L; no public post-mortem beyond trade press; PM names are public figures per Bloomberg/Hedgeweek (no private data); no P&L breakdowns or unwind-cost split disclosed
